payload.evidence_against: Existing 142 summaries and coordinate-only surface reconstruction barely predict the hidden displacement. Only 773 wells are available and GR is partially missing.
payload.evidence_for: Six hidden-offset components are nearly collinear (PC1 99.5626%) and privileged displacement features explain multi-RMSE E003 headroom. All required raw inference channels exist at test time.
payload.next_test: Execute the frozen T031 auxiliary-state gate only; no TVT model until GO.
payload.statement: Boundary-aware horizontal and typewell sequences can predict the one-dimensional E003 hidden formation displacement strongly enough to unlock transferable spline-coefficient learning.
payload.title: Raw legal sequences identify latent formation displacement
